Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Recording of Earnings Call/ Conference Call 
 
In continuation to our letter dated May 21, 2026 bearing reference no. 05/SE/LC/2026-27, 
regarding intimation of Investors/Analyst Earnings Call/ Conference Call on Audited Financial 
Results of Company for the Quarter and Year ended March 31, 2026, we would like to inform 
you that the audio recording of the said call has been uploaded on the Company’s website. 
This can be accessed via the following link:  
https://www.enterohealthcare.com/investor/documents/Financials/Earning_Call_Transcript
s/earning_call-jan-mar-2026.mp3 
The transcript for the said call will be shared with the Stock Exchanges and will also be 
uploaded on the Company’s website (www.enterohealthcare.com) in due course. 
Yours faithfully, 
For Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited 
 
 
 
Sanu Kapoor 
Vice President- General Counsel, Company Secretary  
& Compliance Officer 
 
 
 
 
SANU 
VISHAL 
KAPOOR
Digitally signed 
by SANU VISHAL 
KAPOOR
